name: TC-323: admin links an existing store (menu kept) — its own items interleave at that location only — and unlinks it
description: POST /api/admin/chains/:gid/restaurants/:rid/link {menu:'keep'} on a throwaway store that has its own menu: the owner's /api/chains/owned shows locationCount 3; the store's merged menu carries the chain's shared categories PLUS its own item (source RESTAURANT), which no other location sees; POST …/unlink (never went live → allowed) → 200 {dissolved:false}, chain back to 2 locations.
